listings.remarks: An incredible value for an exceptional Lake Oswego home! Welcome to a peaceful waterfront oasis nestled on the banks of Palisades Lake, your own private nature retreat. listings.remarks: Space, flexibility and a rare amount of breathing room come together in this 3,220-square-foot Stonegate at Waterhouse home. With four bedrooms, a dedicated main-level office, a 3-car garage and a level .29-acre corner lot, this home offers a combination that is increasingly difficult to find on Portland’s west side. High ceilings and abundant natural light enhance the formal living and dining spaces, while the kitchen features quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, a cooking island, pantry and casual dining area. The adjoining family room with fireplace opens directly to the backyard, where a patio, gazebo and generous yard create plenty of room for entertaining and outdoor living. A main-level office with built-ins and a bay window provides a true work-from-home space without sacrificing a bedroom. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet, double sinks, jetted tub and separate shower, while three additional bedrooms include an oversized 27' x 20' fourth bedroom with built-in storage—ideal for guests, hobbies, a gym, media room or additional flex space. Recent improvements include interior paint in most rooms, new carpet in several spaces, a newer roof, trimmed trees and fresh bark mulch. All in an established westside neighborhood near walking paths, recreation, dining and convenient Hwy 26 access.

Welcome to the highly desired Renaissance Pointe neighborhood. Built in 2004, this breath taking home offers a traditional setting tastefully blended with custom features and upgrades. This gem sits on a generous 11K+ sq/ft lot that also backs to a lush green belt offering calming views, charming wildlife, and the whisper of the trees in the wind. Words barely describe the generous spaces within the home: the gourmet kitchen, the stunning triple decks overlooking the green belt, the thoughtful floorplan to accommodate a diverse style of living, and the intentional flow design. There is plenty of storage throughout. The backyard offers a private trail to the green belt, with a bench to stop at to take it all in. Renaissance Pointe HOA includes usage of the neighborhood pool. This turn key home is the perfect blend of elegance and functionality. Conveniently located near Cooper Mountain Nature Park, Progress Ridge, and the highly sought after school district that includes Mountainside High School. Be sure to see the features list!
